purpose: Teach: セッティング/余剰/履行/教委/当人/民放/窃盗/終値

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事務所のセッティングを進めろ
lines.en: Get the new office setup moving forward.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Economical phrasing. Expectation of immediate compliance. Weight settles on the verb. No softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。在庫の余剰分を販売いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll handle the excess inventory sales.
lines.style: Professional, affirming. Steady cadence. A beat of acknowledgment, then pivot to action. Clear ownership without over-elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約の履行をしっかり監視しろ
lines.en: And keep a close eye on contract compliance.
lines.style: Measured, emphatic on 'close.' Not raised — just the pressure of importance underneath. The tone of someone checking boxes that matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。教委との折衝も進めております
lines.en: Understood. I'm also coordinating with the education board on their end.
lines.style: Steady, informational. A small upward lift on 'also' — showing initiative. Professional but not stiff. The tone of someone keeping multiple plates steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様当人へのご対応を丁寧にしろ
lines.en: Make sure we're handling customer interactions with care.
lines.style: Direct, unrushed. Emphasis falls on 'care' — not punitive, but clear this matters. The tone of standards being set, not complaints being aired.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。民放広告枠を確保いたしました
lines.en: Understood. I've also secured the commercial broadcast slots.
lines.style: Clipped, confirming. Small pride in 'secured' — showing completion. Efficient pacing. The tone of someone ticking completed tasks from a list.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 警備担当に窃盗対策を徹底させろ
lines.en: Tell security to tighten theft prevention protocols.
lines.style: Sharp, direct. Weight on 'tighten' — this is non-negotiable. No room for interpretation. The tone of delegation that expects adherence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当日終値の集計が完了しました
lines.en: Yes. The closing price tallies are complete.
lines.style: Final, settled. A breath after delivery — this is the last piece. Calm finality. The tone of someone closing out a day's work.
